sentence: This project builds a way to remove a cell surface protein from normal blood cells so radiolabeled antibodies can treat acute myeloid leukemia safely.
This project studies how chronic inflammation is related to the risk of breast cancer, using dietary data and many kinds of molecular data.
This project studies how neural circuits that use certain peptides control binge-like ethanol intake and how the intake differs between the sexes.
This project provides bioinformatics and statistical support and data management for cancer research projects, and shares the data with other researchers.
This project studies how the spinal cord controls motor output by recording the firing of spinal neurons, including changes after spinal cord injury.
This project tests two therapeutics that target metastasis in mouse models and in fresh breast and pancreatic cancer patient tissue.
This project uses a social robot to give caregivers of people with Alzheimer's disease information and ways to manage stress.
This project studies how a protein on activated dendritic cells guides their migration and the later memory T cell responses.
This project tries to find out how a nuclease called angiogenin changes protein synthesis to direct blood vessel growth.
This project provides equipment and expertise to measure reactive oxygen species and study redox signaling in cells related to cardiovascular disease.
This project studies how circular pieces of DNA outside chromosomes form, work and help cancers resist treatment.
This project studies the molecular pathways and cell responses that go wrong in pediatric frequent asthma exacerbators.
This project tries to sharpen the images made by magnetic particle imaging, a medical imaging technique that scans without radiation.
This project studies what antibodies do in hepatitis E virus infection and whether they can prevent or cure chronic infection.
This project uses zebrafish to study how the peptide apelin affects muscle aging and regeneration.
This project studies how modifications added to proteins control the RNA-methylating enzyme complexes.
This project studies protein changes caused by exercise in the skeletal muscle of younger and older adults to understand muscle aging.
This project studies how mesenchymal stem cells and neutrophils interact during rapid maxillary expansion.
This project uses mobile health technology to measure pain and physical function in real time for people having lumbar spine surgery.
This project studies how a muscle protein called DTX3L affects insulin resistance and cardiac dysfunction in sepsis.
